description: AI-powered state expansion planning tool for OnCourse Systems for Education

stories.title: Create backend project structure
stories.description: Initialize Python project with FastAPI. Create src/backend directory with main.py, requirements.txt, and basic FastAPI app that returns health check at /health

stories.title: Create frontend project structure
stories.description: Initialize Next.js project with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS in src/frontend directory
acceptance_criteria: src/frontend is a valid Next.js project

stories.title: Create database models file
stories.description: Create src/backend/models.py with SQLAlchemy models for State table (id, name, abbreviation, doe_website, created_at, updated_at)

stories.title: Create database connection module
stories.description: Create src/backend/database.py with PostgreSQL connection using SQLAlchemy async. Support DATABASE_URL environment variable.

stories.title: Add StateRequirement model
stories.description: Add StateRequirement model to models.py with fields: id, state_id (FK), requirement_name, description, data_type, submission_format, created_at

stories.title: Create states API router
stories.description: Create src/backend/routers/states.py with GET /api/states (list all) and GET /api/states/{id} (get one) endpoints

stories.title: Create Pydantic schemas
stories.description: Create src/backend/schemas.py with Pydantic models for StateBase, StateCreate, StateResponse, StateRequirementBase, StateRequirementResponse

stories.title: Add CRUD operations for states
stories.description: Create src/backend/crud.py with async functions: get_states(), get_state(id), create_state(), update_state(), delete_state()

stories.title: Create seed data for all 50 states
stories.description: Create src/backend/seed_data.py with list of all 50 US states (name, abbreviation) and a function to seed the database

stories.title: Add DOE URLs to seed data
stories.description: Update seed_data.py to include Department of Education website URLs for all 50 states
acceptance_criteria: Each state has doe_website field populated

stories.title: Create Docker Compose for local development
stories.description: Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL service (with pgvector extension) for local development

stories.title: Add Alembic for database migrations
stories.description: Set up Alembic in src/backend for database migrations. Create initial migration for State and StateRequirement tables.

stories.title: Create RankingFactor model
stories.description: Add RankingFactor model to models.py with fields: id, name, weight, description, data_source. This stores configurable ranking criteria.

stories.title: Create StateScore model
stories.description: Add StateScore model to models.py with fields: id, state_id (FK), factor_id (FK), score, calculated_at. Stores ranking scores per state per factor.
acceptance_criteria: Foreign keys to State and RankingFactor

stories.title: Create NCES data model
stories.description: Add NCESData model with fields: id, state_id (FK), total_districts, total_schools, total_students, avg_district_size, data_year

stories.title: Create config module
stories.description: Create src/backend/config.py using Pydantic Settings for environment variables: DATABASE_URL, CLAUDE_API_KEY, DEBUG, etc.
acceptance_criteria: Settings class with all env vars

stories.title: Add ranking API endpoints
stories.description: Create src/backend/routers/rankings.py with GET /api/rankings (ranked list of states) and GET /api/rankings/factors (list ranking factors)

stories.title: Create frontend homepage
stories.description: Create basic homepage in src/frontend that displays app title and links to /rankings and /states pages

stories.title: Create states list page
stories.description: Create /states page in frontend that fetches and displays all 50 states from the API in a table

stories.title: Create rankings page skeleton
stories.description: Create /rankings page in frontend with placeholder for state rankings table. Will be populated in Sprint 2.
